---
title: "Workshop3"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
#https://www.pnas.org/doi/full/10.1073/pnas.1909726116#data-availability
data <- read.csv("../data/workshop3/Workshop3Data.csv")
attach(data)
plot1 <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Management Intensity") +
  ylab()
  theme_classic() +
 scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 3)) 
plot1
```
